universalAnswers.whatHappened: On September 10, DeepSeek introduced V4.1-Flash with native image understanding; one older technical label is scheduled to route to it on September 14.
universalAnswers.plainLanguageIdentity: A model does the generating behind an app’s interface, and the app maker chooses which model to connect.
universalAnswers.evidenceBasis: DeepSeek’s September 10 announcement supports the model and September 14 route; Vercel’s September 9 announcement supports availability through its AI Gateway.
universalAnswers.evidenceLimits: The announcements establish the model capability and named routes. They do not identify the features of every app.
universalAnswers.readerRelevance: A reader can understand why a picture-aware model may matter to an app she uses without confusing the model announcement with the app’s own feature release.
universalAnswers.affectedPeople: The picture capability matters through apps that connect the model and pass it an image; the September 14 technical change applies to requests using the named older label.
universalAnswers.changesNow: V4.1-Flash is available with image understanding. The older deepseek-v4-pro label is scheduled to route to it on September 14.
universalAnswers.uncertainty: The sources do not identify which specific apps connect the model or which picture features those apps expose.
universalAnswers.readerAction: Check whether the specific app accepts a picture and what the app says it can do with it.
universalAnswers.betterQuestion: What can the model receive, and has this app been built to pass that material to it?

model-tool-release.productRange: V4.1-Flash is available through DeepSeek’s API and Vercel’s AI Gateway; a specific app’s interface and features remain its maker’s choice.
model-tool-release.newCapabilities: DeepSeek describes native multimodal support, and Vercel describes native image understanding.
model-tool-release.bestFitTasks: A conditional photo-app example shows the mechanism: pass a picture to the model so its answer can take the image into account.
model-tool-release.notFor: The announcements do not establish a quality improvement, an individual price, or the features of every app.
model-tool-release.nearestAlternatives: One older label, deepseek-v4-pro, is scheduled to route to V4.1-Flash until V4.1-Pro launches.
model-tool-release.availability: V4.1-Flash is live through the DeepSeek API and available through Vercel AI Gateway.
model-tool-release.freePaidBoundary: No personal price or access-tier claim is made.
model-tool-release.costBoundary: The article does not report a reader price.
model-tool-release.limitations: The September 14 older-label route is a bounded technical note; it does not replace an app’s own feature information.
model-tool-release.technicalExampleProportionality: One photo-app example teaches app maker → selected model → image passed → image-aware answer.
model-tool-release.vendorEvidenceBoundary: DeepSeek supports direct model and route statements; Vercel supports its gateway availability statement.

translation.newsVersionExact: On September 10, DeepSeek introduced V4.1-Flash, a new model with native image understanding.
translation.actualMeaningExact: The new ability is underneath; the app’s own update tells you what is available in the tool you use.
translation.mechanismExact: A model does the generating behind an app’s interface, and the app maker chooses which model to connect.
translation.familiarExampleExact: Picture a photo app: if its maker connects it to V4.1-Flash and passes along the image, the model can consider the picture when it answers.

jargon.plainMeaning: A model does the generating behind an app’s interface, and the app maker chooses which model to connect.

learningConnections.concept: the interface and model are separate layers
learningConnections.learningPayoff: AI Fundamentals 101 chapter 10.2 explains how the interface you see sits above the model doing the generating.
